loadouts.name: Rivet Starter
loadouts.strength: Accurate, frequent shots with the most spare scrap for later build decisions.
loadouts.limitation: One target per basic shot; no starting spread or piercing.

loadouts.name: Scatter Starter
loadouts.strength: Five short-range pellets reward close positioning; each contact deals its own damage.
loadouts.limitation: Less spare scrap, shorter reach and a longer attack interval. Not every pellet will hit.

loadouts.name: Rail Starter
loadouts.strength: Long-reaching piercing shots can hit enemies lined up along their path.
loadouts.limitation: Least spare scrap and the slowest attack interval of these starters.
